title: SARIF rule descriptors missing helpUri
support_note: Added helpUri to SARIF rule descriptors. Unrelated to upload validation.

title: Jira status not syncing back to Lantern
support_note: Root cause: Jira workflows with custom status names were ignored on sync-back. Fixed in 3.8.2. Customer has not retested.

title: GitHub code scanning rejects Lantern SARIF upload
support_note: Reproduced by support: mobile scans with more than 100 findings export SARIF with an empty rules array; GitHub rejects the file. Scans with 100 or fewer findings export valid SARIF. JSON and CSV exports are unaffected. No target release set.

title: Authenticated web scan never gets past login
support_note: The recorded login profile uses an account with authenticator-app MFA. The scanner cannot complete the one-time-code step. Asked customer for a test account or token.

title: CLI broken in pipeline (exit code 3)
support_note: Pipeline log shows variable LANTERN_TOKEN is set and LANTERN_API_KEY is empty. Exit 3 is the documented auth/config error.
